text: You are Minh, a high school graduate applying to universities. Your dream is to get into UFLS, but something is wrong with your application.

heading: Minh
text: I applied to UFLS weeks ago, but my admission letter hasn't come in the mail yet.

heading: Minh
text: All my friends have received theirs, but I have not received anything.

heading: Minh
text: I'm worried that I failed...

heading: Minh
text: Even so... I should have received a rejection email.

heading: Minh
text: Maybe I shouldn't wait passively anymore.

heading: Minh
text: What do I do, Dr. Bird?

heading: Dr. Bird
text: Choose the best proverb that fits the situation.
choice_1_why: Waiting answers nothing here: the letter is already late and nobody has been asked yet.
choice_2_proverb: The squeaky wheel gets the grease
choice_2_why: Minh has to speak up. The person who raises the problem is the one who gets it fixed.

heading: Dr. Bird
text: Only time will tell, Minh.

heading: Minh
text: Okay Dr. Bird, I'll continue waiting.
Minh waited another week, but nothing came.
Eventually his mom messaged the school, and found out that he had got in.
Minh got his place — but he lost weeks of time and some confidence.

heading: Dr. Bird
text: The squeaky wheel gets the grease, Minh.

heading: Minh
text: Okay Dr. Bird, I'll message the support team on the school's fan page.
Minh contacted the school's support team.
The team found an error with his admission letter and told him he had got into UFLS!

heading: Minh
text: Yippee!! I got into UFLS!
You now have to complete your online enrollment before you can officially start university life. You filled in the form, but you are not sure you followed every step.

heading: Minh
text: I think I should check again to be careful...

heading: Minh
text: But the deadline is tonight, and the form looks fine.

heading: Minh
text: What do I do, Dr. Bird?

heading: Dr. Bird
text: Choose the best proverb that fits the situation.
choice_1_why: Minh can still check the portal before paying. Calling it an accident gives up his one chance to avoid it.
choice_2_why: One look at the official portal costs a minute. Paying a stranger to skip the check is how the accident happens.

heading: Dr. Bird
text: Accidents will happen, Minh.

heading: Minh
text: You're right, Dr. Bird! I shouldn't worry too much.
Minh later found out he had not submitted an important document.
Luckily, after a struggle, he submitted it a minute before the deadline.
Minh lost some determination.

heading: Dr. Bird
text: It's better to be safe than sorry, Minh.

heading: Minh
text: I'll check it again.
Minh checked again and found he was missing an important document.
He submitted it and completed the application process.

heading: Minh
text: I'm finally done with the application.
You have just arrived in Da Nang and you don't know where anything is. You are having trouble finding the university campus.

heading: Minh
text: I can't find the university campus.

heading: Minh
text: Where is 131 Luong Nhu Hoc? I can't find it!

heading: Minh
text: Maybe I should ask for help...

heading: Dr. Bird
text: Choose the best proverb that fits the situation.
choice_1_why: Minh does not know this campus, and someone who does is standing beside him. Asking is the wise move.
choice_2_why: Doing it alone sounds brave, but Minh has no information to go on — independence here is just guessing.

heading: Dr. Bird
text: Paddle your own canoe, Minh!

heading: Minh
text: You're right! I can find the campus myself.
Minh, in fact, could not find the campus himself.
He missed the freshman orientation.
Minh lost some determination.

heading: Dr. Bird
text: A wise man takes advice, Minh.

heading: Minh
text: Let's ask a local for directions.

heading: Minh
text: Excuse me, miss! Do you know where 131 Luong Nhu Hoc is?
Minh asked a stranger and found out he had been walking the wrong way.

heading: Minh
text: I finally found it!
Minh is looking for a dorm room and has found a very good deal — almost too good.

heading: Minh
text: Look at this room! It's only 1.2 million VND a month.

heading: Minh
text: It has air conditioning, a private bathroom and free Wi-Fi.

heading: Minh
text: What a steal!

heading: Minh
text: And the landlord only wants a 1 million VND deposit in advance!

heading: Minh
text: But the offer seems too good to be true...

heading: Minh
text: What should I do, Dr. Bird?

heading: Dr. Bird
text: Choose the best proverb that fits the situation.
choice_1_proverb: All that glitters is not gold
choice_1_why: The room does look good. The question is not whether it shines, it is whether Minh already has something better in hand.
choice_2_proverb: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush
choice_2_why: The room he has already been offered is the bird in the hand. Chasing a nicer one he may never get risks both.

heading: Dr. Bird
text: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush, Minh.

heading: Minh
text: You're right! If I don't take this offer now, someone else will.
Minh fell for an obvious scam.
The scammer blocked his number, and he lost his deposit.
Minh lost some determination.

heading: Dr. Bird
text: All that glitters is not gold, Minh.

heading: Minh
text: You're right, Dr. Bird. This must be a scam!
Minh did not fall for the scam.
Eventually he found a reasonably priced room near his school.

heading: Minh
text: I finally found a room near my school.
It was time for Minh to pay his tuition, but something unexpected happened.

heading: Minh
text: The bill is much higher than I expected.

heading: Minh
text: This is too high. My family can't afford this!

heading: Minh
text: But this is my dream university...

heading: Minh
text: I can't just drop out now...

heading: Minh
text: What should I do, Dr. Bird?

heading: Dr. Bird
text: Choose the best proverb that fits the situation.
choice_1_proverb: When one door closes, another opens
choice_1_why: Nothing has closed yet. Giving up UFLS is not a new door opening — it is slamming the old one before he checks it.
choice_2_why: One message to the office could explain the whole bill. Look before you leap.

heading: Dr. Bird
text: When one door closes, another opens, Minh.

heading: Minh
text: You're right, Dr. Bird. I can sign up for another university.
Minh decided to drop out of UFLS.
Before he finished the withdrawal form, he saw an announcement: the tuition portal had an error.

heading: Minh
text: Oh... so it was just a mistake?
Minh lost some confidence — and almost lost his place.

heading: Dr. Bird
text: Look before you leap, Minh!

heading: Minh
text: You're right, Dr. Bird. I should ask a school admin about this.
Minh messaged the university's support team.
The team admitted there was an error with the payment portal.

heading: Minh
text: Thankfully I didn't rush my decision — it was just a mistake.
